title: Over $19M Reported Lost to Jury Duty Fraud at One ATM Firm

lines.say: Over nineteen million dollars. Victims reported losing that to jury duty fraud at one crypto A.T.M. company, a federal affidavit says.
lines.show: Over $19 million. Victims reported losing that to jury duty fraud at one crypto ATM company, a federal affidavit says.

scene.label: REPORTED LOST|AT ONE CRYPTO ATM FIRM

lines.say: Between September twenty twenty-two and May twenty twenty-six, over forty percent of those victims paid money mules in Georgia.
lines.show: Between September 2022 and May 2026, over 40 percent of those victims paid money mules in Georgia.

lines.say: The scheme, the affidavit says: a fake warrant, a gag order, then cash into a crypto machine.

scene.label: Source: Eyewitness News ABC7NY · FBI warning on bitcoin ATM scams (file footage) · Dec 2025

lines.say: One victim report in the affidavit: an elderly Texas woman paid ten thousand dollars at a crypto A.T.M. after more than six hours on the phone.
